newsitem.title: UK: Paribas appoints Hawley govt trading head.
newsitem.headline: Paribas appoints Hawley govt trading head.

text.p: International investment bank Paribas said on Wednesday it had appointed Bob Hawley as Global Head of Government Trading in its latest move to strengthen its London based operations.

Before joining Paribas, Hawley was Managing Director of Credit Suisse First Boston in London, where he was responsible for establishing and managing their European Government Trading Department, Paribas said in a statement.
A Paribas official said the appointment showed the bank's strong commitment to becoming a world leader in government bond trading.
